title.en: Anthropic Previews the Model Hardware Standard for Physical-Device Research
title.zhHans: Anthropic 预览面向物理设备研究的模型硬件标准（MHS）

searchSummary.en: Anthropic previewed the Model Hardware Standard on August 27, 2026, proposing a shared interface for AI agents to operate selected laboratory and physical devices in a partner research program.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 8 月 27 日预览模型硬件标准（MHS），在合作伙伴研究计划中提出供 AI 智能体操作部分实验室与物理设备的共享接口。

summary.en: Anthropic announced a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), developed with partners including HHMI Janelia, Genentech, and CMU. MHS proposes drivers and basic read/write primitives to connect AI systems with laboratory instruments and other devices. Access is limited to invited research partners; Anthropic says it intends eventual open-source release, not that an open standard is already established.
summary.zhHans: Anthropic 宣布模型硬件标准（MHS）研究预览，合作方包括 HHMI Janelia、Genentech 与 CMU。MHS 提出驱动层及基础读写原语，用于连接 AI 系统与实验室仪器等设备。访问仅限受邀研究伙伴；Anthropic 表示计划最终开源，而非一个已经确立的开放标准。

narrative.en: MHS extends the interface idea behind MCP into physical equipment. Anthropic describes partner demonstrations such as multi-instrument experiments and says the specification is model-agnostic. It also says models still struggle with physical troubleshooting, such as handling bubbles in fluids. Claims about integration speed are early Anthropic-reported examples, not independently established performance across laboratories or manufacturers.
narrative.zhHans: MHS 将 MCP 背后的接口理念延伸至物理设备。Anthropic 描述了多仪器实验等合作伙伴演示，并称该规范不绑定特定模型。它也承认模型仍难以处理诸如液体气泡等物理故障。关于集成速度的说法是 Anthropic 早期报告的案例，而不是已经在各实验室或制造商中独立确立的性能。

description.en: Tests a proposed shared driver interface for AI systems and physical instruments in a constrained research preview.
description.zhHans: 在受限研究预览中测试 AI 系统与物理仪器之间拟议的共享驱动接口。

description.en: Anthropic reports early partner examples of faster device integration, which remain to be validated beyond the preview program.
description.zhHans: Anthropic 报告了合作伙伴中更快设备集成的早期案例，仍需在预览计划之外得到验证。

text.en: Anthropic previewed MHS on August 27, 2026 with partners including HHMI Janelia, Genentech, and CMU.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 8 月 27 日预览 MHS，合作方包括 HHMI Janelia、Genentech 与 CMU。

text.en: MHS proposes standardized device drivers and read/write primitives for orchestrating selected physical equipment through AI systems.
text.zhHans: MHS 提出标准化设备驱动与读写原语，用于通过 AI 系统协调部分物理设备。

text.en: MHS is an invited research preview, not a generally available open-source standard, and Anthropic describes remaining need for human physical troubleshooting.
text.zhHans: MHS 是受邀研究预览，而非普遍可用的开源标准；Anthropic 也描述了仍需要人工处理物理故障的情形。
